# #18 Reader font size + content width — blind QA report

**Verdict: PASS.** No blocker or major defects. Three minor notes are listed below.
Method: blind (no diff or src/ read). Real Chromium against throwaway stacks (`scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node .verify/qa/18/qa{,2,3,4}.mjs`).
Final tally: qa.mjs 48/52, and all 4 misses were bugs in my own script. I re-ran them correctly in qa2/qa3, and they pass there. qa4 had 1 false positive: its selector matched a heading-gutter icon, and the screenshot shows the image and the mermaid diagram fit the column.
Evidence: `.verify/qa/18/results.json`, `.verify/qa/18/*.png`.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-18.1 PASS: with no stored prefs: scale 100, width narrow. p 15, h1 24, h2 20, h3 16, inline code 13, table 14. Button text "Aa", aria-label "Reading settings", haspopup=dialog, expanded=false, no `.btn-icon`, placed after the Style trigger.
- AC-18.2 PASS: values went 110, 120, 135, 150, then the button disabled. At 150%: p 22.5, h1 36, code 19.5 (also h2 30, table 21, li 22.5). The panel stayed open.
- AC-18.3 PASS: 80% with A− disabled. p 12, h1 19.2. Reset returns to 100% and becomes disabled.
- AC-18.4 PASS: at 1400×900 narrow, p is 750 wide with 32/32 gaps. Wide: p 1096 = clientWidth 1160 − 64. aria-pressed swaps.
- AC-18.5 PASS: at 150% narrow the pane is 1160, the column is min(1125, 1096) = 1096, and it stays centred.
- AC-18.6 PASS: after a reload, storage reads `{"fontScale":135,"width":"wide"}` and the pane shows both. These stored values all fall back per field with no page error: `{"fontScale":999,"width":"huge"}`, `{`, `5`, `[1,2]`, `null`, `"wide"`, `{"fontScale":105,…}` (wide kept, 100 used), `{"fontScale":"135"}`. With a localStorage getter that throws, the controls still work (110 / wide).
- AC-18.7 PASS: `.cm-content` stays 14px at 120% and at 135%. The button stays visible in Edit. Back in Preview the pane shows 135. Split preview pane: 135 → p 20.25, no horizontal overflow.
- AC-18.8 PASS (all 6 themes): at 120%, p = 18 for Default/Locus and 19.2 for GitHub. Cap = 900 or 960, gaps 32/32. At 100% the GitHub base is 16 (h1 32) and Default/Locus is 15. Locus h1 is 30, which scales to 36. The panel uses each theme's surface colour with a 1px border and 8px radius. The focus ring is a 2px solid outline in every theme.
- AC-18.9 PASS (see note 3): all 5 controls are disabled, the note text is exact, and stored prefs are untouched. The iframe box is identical with no prefs, with 150/wide and with 80/narrow.
- AC-18.10 PASS: Tab reaches the button. Enter opens the panel with focus on font-decrease. Tab moves to font-increase. Space keeps the panel open and raises the value. Escape closes it, returns focus to the button and sets expanded=false. Space also opens it. Tabbing out closes it, and so does clicking outside. At 80%, Enter puts focus on font-increase. When A+ reaches 150 and disables itself, focus moves to font-decrease rather than falling to body.
- AC-18.11 PASS: role=dialog, name "Reading settings", aria-live polite, exactly one aria-pressed=true, labels as specified. axe reports 0 violations in light and in locus-dark.
- AC-18.12 PASS: at 150%, in both widths, on desktop, tablet and phone, the pane and the document both have scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth. The test doc contains a 12-column table, a 600-character unbroken URL and a 400-character code line.
- AC-18.13 PASS: review doc, read view, at 1400 and 2200 wide. Highlights stay at 1 → 1, scrollY stays > 0 after every step, and the commented paragraph stays on screen (top between 406 and 647px). Split view: scrollTop goes 1500 → 1639.
- AC-18.14 PASS: the panel is fully on screen at all three viewports (desktop 1076–1344 × 45–195; phone 0–390, full-width sheet). Screenshots show a centred narrow column and a wide layout that fills the pane.
- AC-18.15: unit test, not re-run here. It belongs to the gate.

## Extra attacks (all PASS)
- **Focus mode (#13) in split view keeps the width setting.** At 1400 the preview half (696) is below the cap. At 2560: narrow gives 750 centred (263/263), wide gives 1212 = cw − 64. Both match the split-view numbers before focus mode, so focus mode does not force full width.
- **Phone overflow menu.** The button is absent from the bar and listed once in the menu, in §2.3 order (Share, Copy link, Reading settings, Library, Home). It opens a full-width sheet, and A+ works in the sheet.
- **Tablet.** The button is in the bar.
- **Print is unaffected by the on-screen scale.** In print media, 150/narrow gives p 15, h1 24, code 13, the same as 100. GitHub look: 16 at 150/wide and at 100/narrow.
- **Rapid clicking.** 60+ rapid and forced clicks on A+/A− never left the 80–150 list, with no console errors.
- **Two tabs.** Each tab keeps its own setting until reload, and a reload picks up the last value written. Switching to another doc carries the prefs over.
- **Theme switch.** Prefs are intact after switching theme.
- **Wide image and mermaid diagram.** Both fit the narrow column at 150% on desktop and on phone.

## Defects / notes (all minor or cosmetic)
1. Minor: clicking `theme-toggle` while the panel is open closes the panel, because it counts as an outside click under rule 9. Values are kept. The spec's edge case says the panel "restyles", but rule 9 makes closing defensible. Repro: open the panel, click the theme toggle (`theme-switch` check).
2. Cosmetic: on phone, Escape closes the sheet and focus returns to `header-overflow-btn`, because the menu item it was opened from no longer exists. This is sensible, but the spec does not say where focus should go.
3. Minor (spec wording): AC-18.9 says "iframe box equals the main pane's", but the iframe is 795px tall and the pane is 848px. #24's `reaction-bar` sits below the iframe inside the main pane, and the gap does not depend on the prefs (`html-panel.png`). The AC text needs updating, not the code. The frozen test may assert the literal equality.
